expansion_blueprint: Masterpiece integration v2.0.0: core 2.0.0 hardening plus ten-field metric standardization across all domain members, 228-case trigger matrix (114+114, SHA 2ba1f166afde7bcd0963b6e7cb818a5f87139da5c5a301f378ee891a207dc02d as of 2026-10-15), 7-task ledger, 8-gate validation, TRACEABILITY, docs, ID aliases, deterministic release.
runtime_exclusion_rationale: Test fixtures under scripts/tests/fixtures/*/SKILL.md would be auto-discovered as phantom skills because opencode scans skills/ recursively for **/SKILL.md (verified empirically on 1.18.31 via tmp-set/nested and 5-level fixture test). Canonical source retains full fixtures for validation; runtime omits the entire scripts/tests tree so only the 13 production SKILL.md files are discovered. Validation/tests/*.py contain no SKILL.md and are safe to keep in runtime. .github/ and .githooks/ are repo CI plumbing with no runtime role and are canonical-only.
relative_path_contract: Runtime preserves set-root layout (all member dirs plus shared/, validation/, manifest.yaml, SET.md as siblings) so ../shared/*, ../../shared/*, ../manifest.yaml and ../validation/* references resolve identically to canonical source.
validation_on_canonical_source: bash validation/validate-set.sh must pass 8/8 gates after restoring +x bits. Re-run after any update.
config_note: No opencode.jsonc change required: ~/.config/opencode/skills/*/SKILL.md (recursive) is auto-loaded. Do not add skills.paths unless moving the set. If added, use new array form per https://opencode.ai/config.json (skills: ["/abs/path"]); object form {paths,urls} is deprecated.
